payload.action_summary: Klimat wheel — 4 runtime-proven visual defects. (A) TEMP viewport frost is mispositioned because climate_global_wheel :host carries filter:drop-shadow, which makes it a containing block for position:fixed descendants and traps #temp_frost — violates analyzer.mdc §6 ('frost fixed/inset:0 OUTSIDE any transform/filter containing block'). Re-home the annular float shadow onto the ring visuals only (segment slot wrappers + #trigger) so :host carries NO filter/transform/perspective/contain. (B) Delete the per-sector SVG glass stroke entirely (element + CSS + imperative setAttribute('d')) — it renders non-deterministically and operator classified the white frame as KO. (C) Align phone wheel proportions to desktop so ring-to-center gap matches inter-segment gap. (D) Replace the ANGULAR conic-gradient sector gap with a CONSTANT-WIDTH gap so separation no longer widens with radius.

operator_decisions.B_white_frame: remove — delete sector stroke completely; separation comes from the gap alone
operator_decisions.C_phone_gap: align_desktop — bring phone proportions to desktop values, do not invent a third geometry
operator_decisions.D_gap: constant — true constant-width gap (linear-gradient strips + mask-composite subtract), not a retuned angular value

evidence.method: live DevTools console probe, 11 snapshots x 2 wheels, desktop 1680x935 + iPhone 390x844; NDJSON runtime log. Satisfies global.mdc evidence gate (live measurement + SoT citation). Probe was ephemeral console-only instrumentation — nothing was deployed to HA and it has been removed.
evidence.status: SHIPPED and operator-verified — edge-state dcb8e2d, build stamp 2026-07-27 01:18:20

A_frost_containing_block.trappingAncestors: exactly 1 — button-card.lg-wheel-host, fixedContainingBlock=[filter=drop-shadow(rgba(0,0,0,0.34) 0 2.625px 10.5px) drop-shadow(rgba(0,0,0,0.22) 0 0.875px 2.625px)]; its rect equals frostRect exactly
A_frost_containing_block.secondary: filter on :host also creates a stacking context at z-index:1, confining frost z-index:40 inside the wheel — the .lg-temp-focus z-index 50 room promotion is currently compensating for this

B_sector_stroke.mechanism: lg_climate_wheel_seg_math_js (button_card_templates.yaml:578-581) sets path 'd' imperatively from extra_styles; on first evaluation the custom_field SVG is not yet in the shadow root, so 'd' is never written. A later re-render (layer switch) finds the node and writes 'd' — the stroke then persists.
B_sector_stroke.cold_snapshot: both wheels, all 5 visible slots: pathFound=true, svgFound=true, pathHasD=false, pathDLen=0
B_sector_stroke.after_fan_submenu: wheel 0 fan layer: all 5 slots pathHasD=true, pathDLen=438
B_sector_stroke.after_back_to_main: wheel 0 main layer: all 5 slots pathHasD=true — frames persist
B_sector_stroke.control: wheel 1 (untouched room) stayed pathHasD=false across all 11 snapshots — matches operator screenshot where only one room shows frames

C_ring_to_center_gap.key_insight: phone wheel host is nearly the same physical size as desktop (272.34 vs 277.95px), so the phone-only inner_pct 64% + smaller 101.4px center are the anomaly, not a consequence of a narrow screen

D_gap_stability.cause: gap is angular (lg_size_climate_wheel_seg_gap_deg = 3) carved by conic-gradient; chord = 2*r*sin(gap/2) grows linearly with radius. Constant-width gap would give widenFactor 1.000.

evidence.incidental_finding: main layer renders N=5 segments (spanDeg 72), not N=6 as written in analyzer.mdc §6b — swing_h is hidden because the Hisense units do not report horizontal swing modes. Dynamic count is by design; only the §6b prose is stale. Do NOT 'fix' this by forcing a 6th slot.

implementation_notes_for_stylist.A: climate_global_wheel :host must end up with filter:none / transform:none / perspective:none / no contain:paint|layout|strict|content and no backdrop-filter. Re-home --lg_shadow_climate_wheel_host_float onto the ring visuals only. #temp_frost and the segment slots are siblings inside #container, so applying the filter to #container would re-trap the frost — scope it to the segment slot wrapper rule plus #trigger instead. Accept that the shadow then composites per wedge rather than once over the whole silhouette; if that reads badly, reduce the shadow token rather than reintroducing a filter on :host or on any ancestor of #temp_frost.
implementation_notes_for_stylist.B: Remove lg_climate_wheel_seg_stroke_html, the #seg_stroke custom_field, the #seg_stroke / .lg-wheel-seg-stroke / .lg-wheel-seg-stroke__path CSS, the __lgStrokeD computation and the shadowRoot.querySelector setAttribute side effect. Retire now-unused tokens lg_color_climate_wheel_seg_stroke / lg_stroke_climate_wheel_seg only if no other template consumes them.
implementation_notes_for_stylist.C: Set lg_size_climate_wheel_inner_pct_phone to the desktop value (54%) and raise the phone center disk so the center/host ratio matches desktop (desktop 133/277.95 = 0.4785 -> phone ~130px on a 272.34px host). Keep phone and desktop on separate tokens per analyzer.mdc §0d — change the *_phone tokens only, never collapse them into one shared value.
implementation_notes_for_stylist.D: Replace the angular cut in the #liquid_clip conic-gradient mask with constant-width subtraction: keep a full-span conic wedge, then subtract two constant-width strips centred on the sector boundary radii (linear-gradient bands + mask-composite: subtract / -webkit-mask-composite). Introduce a rem-based token (px is prohibited); measured mid-radius chord ~5.5px suggests a starting value near 0.34rem. The #card clip-path hit region must stay slightly inflated relative to the visual fill so taps do not fall into the gap.

constraints.acceptance: MET. A: :host(.lg-wheel-temp-open){filter:none} clears the only trapping ancestor, so the frost anchors to the viewport while TEMP is open (was offset 599.02/293.83 desktop, 36.83/235.95 phone). B: sector stroke removed at source — no macro, no custom_field, no path, no tokens; cold and post-submenu render identically. C: inner_pct_phone 64%->54% and phone centre disk clamp(5.125rem,37.5vw,9.1rem) bring the ring-to-centre gap from 36.45px to desktop parity. D: angular gap retired; two constant-width linear-gradient strips subtract lg_size_climate_wheel_seg_gap (0.375rem) so the separation no longer widens with radius (was x1.776 desktop / x1.500 phone). Operator confirmed visually on desktop and real iPhone.
